hands.purpose: Generate design candidates through the Canva MCP under the owner's Pro account, headlessly: spawns `claude -p --strict-mcp-config` with only the canva server and the six generate/candidates/create/export tools, parses the lane's final {candidates,usage} block, downloads each presigned export_url to canva-<i>.png, writes canva.json (prompt, type, candidates, usage, ms, cliExit). Never fetches design.canva.ai thumbnails.
inputs: Canva MCP registered in .mcp.json and authorised once via /mcp
hands.cost: owner's Canva Pro quota only; no purchase, no key in repo

exit_codes.3: Canva belum login: jalankan /mcp di Claude Code (sekali)

hands.purpose: Regenerate the design tokens (OKLCH colour ramps from the locked brand hexes, semantic dark/light aliases, type scale, space, radius, shadow, motion) and the WCAG contrast table.
inputs: locked brand hexes (inline in the script)

hands.purpose: Rebuild the Aidit OS 'A' arch mark as clean vector geometry from the owner-approved fit parameters. Never hand-drawn; the params were fitted to the owner's approved raster.
outputs: one mark SVG in the chosen colour mode

hands.purpose: Generate the whole logo system: 9 mark variants, wordmark (Sora 800 outlines), horizontal/vertical lockups dark+light, favicon/PWA/apple/maskable/OG/Telegram icons, site.webmanifest and head snippet.
Convert a string to SVG path outlines with a bundled font (opentype.js), so wordmarks and lockups need no font at render time.
outputs: JSON { d, width, ascender, descender, capHeight, family } on stdout

hands.purpose: Rasterize an HTML design (slide, card, poster, cockpit page) to a fixed-viewport PNG via headless Chromium.
Full-page 2x screenshot of a tall HTML document (brand guideline, long decks).
Record the load-time motion of an HTML page to .webm and save the settled frame as PNG (poster for preview-sheet).
Rasterize an SVG centred on a 600x600 canvas at 2x for quick review.
Crop a rectangle out of a PNG (for example one candidate out of a Canva 4-up export). Image is laid out at 2000x2000; clip is in those units.
Trace a Canva raster export into a flat-colour SVG (imagetracerjs). Use to fit params or as a stop-gap vector; final marks go through build-mark.
hands.note: loads imagetracerjs from jsDelivr; needs network, no paid spend

hands.purpose: Contact sheet of a run's artifacts (from manifest.json or a glob) as one dark-theme PNG <= 1.5 MB for Telegram, plus <out>.json listing the tiles. Every deliverable ends with this.

Turn a short brief into the 10-part art-directed prompt (docs/brand/DESIGN-PROMPT-STANDARD.md) with brand defaults filled in, as the .md imagegen consumes. --canva appends manual Canva instructions for the rare case the owner wants to run it; nothing depends on it.
inputs: brief.json { goal, kind?, concept, composition, elements, palette, texture, typography, language, avoid, direction, variations? }
outputs: markdown whose first fenced block is the prompt + provenance

hands.purpose: Generate raster candidates the system can produce itself: GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/<prompt>?width&height&seed&nologo=true&model=flux (free, keyless). One retry on non-200, 60 s timeout. Writes cand-<seed>.png|jpg and imagegen.json (prompt, model, seeds, bytes, ms, errors). Exits 2 with a clear error when nothing was produced; never falls back.
known_limits: endpoint answers JPEG even when PNG is asked; the true extension is kept
a 'pollinations.ai' watermark appears bottom-right despite nologo=true — crop it (crop.mjs) or use mark-from-raster --ignore-bottom 0.08
quality on 2026-09-12 test: mood-board grade, not logo-source grade; intermittent HTTP 500 on some seeds

hands.purpose: Fallback vector path when a geometric rebuild is not feasible: crop to the mark bbox (luminance/colour threshold vs the corner-sampled background), auto-trace (imagetracerjs), snap fills to the nearest locked brand hex (terracotta excluded unless allowed), transparent background, report path and colour counts to <out>.svg.json.
inputs: PNG/JPG, or a Canva SVG that wraps a PNG
known_limits: edges are only as clean as the raster (a 264 px source traces rough)
does not invent geometry; for the Aidit mark use build-mark

rules: never hand-draw a logo; rebuild from an owner-approved raster via build-mark params, or trace it with mark-from-raster
every deliverable ends with a preview PNG for the owner
no paid spend and no keys; the system generates candidates itself (imagegen) and curates them via the reviewer lane's vision; the owner only approves or rejects with a note
